statement: Rename everything to kinbase; I'll ratify it as valid. We don't have to play by the rules we make up. If there's no apparent or future-scoped 'guildhall', then it doesn't matter that much.
authority_effect: Ratifies the specification as renamed. The rename moved every schema string, domain separator, HTTP header, environment variable and on-disk path from guildhall-* to kinbase-*, which re-keys every signature preimage and every content-addressed event path. The founder holds that nothing outside this repository holds a guildhall-signed event, so there is nothing to migrate. Does not establish proof, sign a terminal verdict, or authorize outcome-experiment spending.
provenance: Exact user message in the active Claude Code conversation, projected by the Validator; no external cryptographic signature is claimed. This matches the provenance of the receipt it supersedes.
